prompts.masterPrompt:
Build a production-grade "Obsidian Dark & Burnt Orange — Sidebar Application Workspace" interface matching a 1024×768 (4:3) capture with dark ground polarity.

### 1. Executive Summary & Aesthetic Direction
- **Screen Archetype**: High-precision operational web interface
- **Luminance & Atmosphere**: Dark Ground architecture anchored on #101010 (45% canvas coverage) with elevated #303040 containers, subtle `1px solid #504030` structural hairlines, crisp #A0B0C0 display typography, and high-saturation #402010 interactive calls-to-action.
- **Visual Discipline**: Combine generous negative space with exposed structural column rules, sharp typographic hierarchy, and zero unmotivated decorative clutter.

### 2. Spatial Grid & Viewport Topology
- **Measured Frame**: `1024px × 768px` (4:3)
- **Grid Architecture**: Fixed Left Sidebar Rail + Multi-Column Main Canvas
- **Container & Gutters**: `max-width: 1280px` centered container with `48px–56px` outer horizontal padding, `24px–32px` column gutters, and subtle full-height vertical grid guide hairlines (`1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` on dark ground / `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)` on light ground).
- **Density & Vertical Rhythm**: Structured Operational (8px Spatial Rhythm · 24px–32px Card Gutters).

### 3. Surface & Chromatic Token System
- **Primary Canvas Ground**: `#101010` (main viewport background and negative space)
- **Elevated Surface / Card Plane**: `#303040` (contained cards, banners, and structural modules)
- **Glassmorphic / Translucent Overlay**: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and `1px solid #504030`
- **Primary Display & Headline Ink**: `#A0B0C0` (H1/H2 display titles, numeric counters, active labels)
- **Secondary Body & Muted Ink**: `#D0D0C0` (body paragraphs, section kickers, navigation links, captions)
- **Primary Interactive CTA Accent**: `#402010` (pill CTA buttons, active navigation indicators, focus rings)
- **Structural Hairline & Grid Border**: `#504030` (card borders, section dividers, input outlines)

### 4. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Hero & Display Headlines (H1/H2)**: Geometric/Neo-grotesque sans-serif, `32px–48px` (`clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 3rem)`), weight `500–600`, tight tracking (`-0.025em`), line-height `1.15`, set in `#A0B0C0`.
- **Inline Section Kickers**: Parenthetical or uppercase micro-labels (`12px–13px`, `#D0D0C0`) positioned inline or indented ahead of the first line of section headings (`text-indent: 9rem` on desktop).
- **Card Titles & Index Numerals**: Oversized tabular index counters (`36px–44px`, weight `400`, `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) paired with `16px–18px` weight `600` subheadings in `#A0B0C0`.
- **Body Copy & Captions**: `14px–15px` regular weight (`400`), line-height `1.65`, comfortable `55ch–65ch` measure in `#D0D0C0`.

### 5. Section-by-Section & Component Anatomy (Top to Bottom)
1. **Top Command & Navigation Header**:
   - Full-width horizontal header bar (`height: 60px–68px`, `background: #303040`, `border-bottom: 1px solid #504030`, `padding: 0 32px`) housing primary brand/breadcrumb identity on the left, global context switches in the center, and a high-contrast primary action button (`background: #402010`, `color: #FFFFFF`, `border-radius: 8px`) on the right.
2. **Primary Structural Workspace (Fixed Left Sidebar Rail + Multi-Column Main Canvas)**:
   - Anchored on a #101010 canvas ground with subtle `1px solid #504030` structural dividers and an 8px spatial spacing scale.
   - Left/Upper primary content zone featuring elevated #303040 cards (`border: 1px solid #504030`, `border-radius: 8px–10px`, `padding: 24px`) with bold #A0B0C0 headers, #D0D0C0 specification metadata, and semantic status badges.
3. **Secondary Inspector / Analytical Detail Zone**:
   - Synchronized detail panels and data tables using `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` for all coordinates, metrics, timestamps, and percentage deltas.

### 6. Implementation & CSS Architecture Guardrails
- Use semantic HTML5 landmarks (`<header>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<article>`, `<footer>`) and CSS custom properties for all colors, spacing, and radii.
- Enforce `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on all numbered lists, metrics, and counters.
- Lock media containers with explicit `aspect-ratio` and `object-fit: cover` so layout geometry never shifts during image loading.

• Responsive Breakpoint Collapse: 12-column desktop grid collapses to 2-column tablet grid (<1024px) and single-column vertical flow (<640px) with 24px horizontal padding

title: Prime Realty Estate — Luxury Architectural Property Landing Page

metrics.densityProfile: Multi-Section Editorial Rhythm (8 Vertical Bands · 80px–120px Section Padding)

prompts.masterPrompt:
Build a production-grade dark luxury architectural real estate landing page ("Prime Realty Estate") matching a 640×3118 (1:4.9 Full-Page Vertical Scroll) capture with dark ground architecture.

### 1. Executive Summary & Aesthetic Direction
- **Screen Archetype**: Luxury residential & commercial real estate showcase landing page spanning 8 distinct vertical narrative sections.
- **Luminance & Atmosphere**: Deep obsidian dark mode (`#101010` canvas ground) paired with warm amber-lit twilight architectural photography, subtle full-height vertical column guide hairlines (`1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`), translucent glassmorphic overlay cards, crisp white geometric typography (`#F4F4F6`), and vibrant burnt-orange pill CTAs (`#F08020`).
- **Signature Editorial Motif**: Major section H2 headings use an inline parenthetical micro-kicker on the first line (e.g., `(About Us)`, `(We Serve)`, `(Our Services)`, `(Why Us)`, `(Our Work)`, `(Let's Connect)`) separated from the indented first line of the display headline.

### 2. Spatial Grid & Viewport Topology
- **Measured Capture**: `640px × 3118px` full-page scroll (scales to a `1280px–1440px` desktop container with `56px` outer horizontal padding and a 4-column / 12-column exposed vertical hairline grid).
- **Vertical Section Rhythm**: 8 sequential bands separated by `80px–110px` vertical padding (`padding-block`) and anchored to the continuous vertical grid lines.

### 3. Surface & Chromatic Token System
- **Primary Canvas Ground**: `#101010` (main page backdrop across all editorial sections)
- **Elevated Banner & Card Surface**: `#181818` to `#1E1E22` (used on the "Let's Connect" CTA card and footer form container)
- **Glassmorphic Overlay Card**: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)` border
- **Primary Display & Headline Ink**: `#F4F4F6` (hero H1, section H2s, `01`–`04` index counters, card titles)
- **Secondary Body & Kicker Ink**: `#9A9AA2` (body paragraphs, parenthetical kickers, navigation links)
- **Primary Interactive CTA Accent**: `#F08020` (burnt-orange pill buttons, active nav home icon/link, footer subscribe button, brand monogram icon)
- **Structural Hairline & Grid Rule**: `#2A2A2E` / `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)`

### 4. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Hero Display Title (H1)**: Geometric sans-serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans` / `Inter`), `40px–52px`, weight `500`, line-height `1.14`, tracking `-0.02em`, color `#F4F4F6` ("Luxury Living Spaces Designed For Modern Life").
- **Section Display Headings (H2)**: `26px–34px`, weight `500`, line-height `1.24`, color `#F4F4F6`, with first-line `text-indent: 140px` so the `12px` `#9A9AA2` parenthetical kicker (`(About Us)`, `(We Serve)`, etc.) sits at the left column margin.
- **Service Index Numerals (`01`–`04`)**: `44px` light/regular geometric sans (`weight: 400`, `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`), color `#F4F4F6`.
- **Card Titles & Body Copy**: `15px–16px` weight `600` `#F4F4F6` card titles paired with `13px–14px` line-height `1.6` `#9A9AA2` descriptions.
- **Oversized Footer Wordmark**: Full-bleed uppercase display text `PRIME REALTY ESTATE` (`clamp(3.5rem, 11vw, 9rem)`, weight `700`, tracking `0.04em`, color `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28)`), clipped along the bottom viewport edge.

### 5. Section-by-Section & Component Anatomy (Top to Bottom)
1. **Header & Hero Showcase (Y: 0–470px)**:
   - Top navigation bar (`height: 68px`) with left `#F08020` geometric building monogram logo, center-right nav links (`Home` active in `#F08020` with house icon, `About Us`, `Services`, `Properties`, `Contact Us` in `#E0E0E0`), and right `#F08020` rounded pill CTA button `Book Appointment`.
   - Asymmetric 2-column hero over a moody dark skyline glow: left column holds the 3-line H1, 3-line lead paragraph, and `#F08020` `Book Appointment` button; right column features a dramatic upward-angled cutout render of a curved, illuminated modern glass condominium tower overlapping the bottom hero edge.
2. **(About Us) Asymmetric Split Section (Y: 470–990px)**:
   - Top inline kicker `(About Us)` + 3-line H2 headline across the upper grid.
   - Below: left 55% column features a large twilight photograph of a modern glass villa with illuminated stone walkway; center-right column contains a 6-line narrative paragraph and `#F08020` `Book Appointment` CTA; far-right edge bleeds an offset secondary architectural detail image.
3. **(We Serve) Full-Bleed Atmospheric Glassmorphic Strip (Y: 990–1390px)**:
   - Full-width darkened architectural background image with top `(We Serve)` kicker + 3-line H2 ("Luxury Properties Crafted For Modern Living...").
   - 4-column horizontal row below: 3 translucent glassmorphic cards (`Luxury Villas`, `Modern Apartments`, `Commercial Spaces`) framed by `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)` borders with title at top-left and micro-description at bottom-left, plus a 4th right-hand column of narrative copy.
4. **(Our Services) Numbered 01–04 Architectural Index (Y: 1390–1820px)**:
   - `(Our Services)` kicker + 3-line H2 ("Premium Developments Built For Comfort...").
   - 4-column horizontal grid (`01 Luxury Towers`, `02 Modern Residences`, `03 City Communities`, `04 Luxury...` overflowing slightly right): each column stacks the large `01` numeral, bold title, 3-line description, `Learn More ↗` link, and a rounded rectangular architectural photo thumbnail (`border-radius: 8px`, `aspect-ratio: 16/10`).
5. **(Why Us) Balanced Split Showcase (Y: 1820–2210px)**:
   - 2-column split: left half repeats the illuminated modern house twilight photo; right half stacks `(Why Us)` kicker, 2-line H2 ("Helping You Invest In The Right Property"), two paragraphs of investment advisory copy, and a `#F08020` `Book Appointment` button.
6. **(Our Work) Staggered 3-Column Portfolio Grid (Y: 2210–2660px)**:
   - `(Our Work)` kicker + 3-line H2 ("Exceptional Spaces Designed For Modern Life...").
   - 3-column vertical portrait card grid (`Skyline Residences`, `Garden Estate Homes`, `Harbor View Towers`): columns 1 and 3 align at the top while column 2 (`Garden Estate Homes`) is staggered downward by `40px` for editorial rhythm. Each card shows a vertical portrait architectural photo above a bold title and 3-line description.
7. **(Let's Connect) Elevated CTA Banner with Overlapping Cutout (Y: 2660–2890px)**:
   - Contained `#181818` rounded card (`border: 1px solid #2A2A2E`, `border-radius: 10px`, `padding: 40px`) with `(Let's Connect)` kicker, H2 "Start Your Property Journey Today", 2-line prompt, and `#F08020` `Book Appointment` button on the left, while a symmetrical front-elevation glass building cutout rises out of the right side of the card.
8. **Heroic Image Pre-Footer & Multi-Column Footer (Y: 2890–3118px)**:
   - Full-width dusk architectural banner fading via dark bottom gradient into a 4-column footer: Column 1 (Orange building logo + 5 white circular social icons), Column 2 (`Quick Links` in `#F08020` + 5 vertical links), Column 3 (`Services` in `#F08020` + 5 vertical links), Column 4 (`Lorem Ipsum` contact details with phone/email/location icons, pill input `Enter Your Email` + embedded `#F08020` `Subscribe Now ↗` button, and checkbox `I agree to email receive.`).
   - Centered copyright line above the massive full-bleed `PRIME REALTY ESTATE` wordmark along the bottom edge.

### 6. Implementation & CSS Architecture Guardrails
- Use a persistent 4-column background guide overlay (`pointer-events: none`) with `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` vertical lines.
- Implement the inline section kicker + indented H2 pattern using a relative container where the `(Section Name)` span is positioned at `left: 0; top: 0.35em` and the `h2` uses `text-indent: 9.5rem`.
